images.title: How far in one hour
images.purpose: Show the distance people generally travel in one hour by different means, as a short list with small pictures.
images.composition: A tidy table of eight rows, each a small picture on the left and the words on the right.
images.exact_structure: Eight rows from top to bottom, each with a small flat picture and a text: a walking child 'on foot, 3 to 5 km'; a horse 'horse, 10 to 15 km'; a bicycle 'cycle, 12 to 20 km'; a motorbike 'motorbike, 40 to 60 km'; a ship 'ship, 25 to 45 km'; a train 'train, 40 to 160 km'; an aeroplane 'aircraft, 750 to 920 km'; a rocket 'spacecraft, at least 28,000 km'. The title above the table reads 'In one hour'. Pictures use flat fills in #0072B2, #E69F00, #009E73 and #CC79A7.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Distances in one hour range from a 1 digit number to a 5 digit number.
